1a2b90bf3660cb937042b9fb12ce5e24a0d67bbb.subject: Improve HTTP file mappers
1a2b90bf3660cb937042b9fb12ce5e24a0d67bbb.reason: Path-traversal containment, not the refactor the subject suggests: Map() now resolves the full path and returns null if it escapes a new abstract FolderPath. Verified against the live 6969 instance first - not currently exploitable, ASP.NET normalises every vector before routing and a canary above appdata returns 404 - so this is defence in depth, not a live bug fix.

1ce378356645c21dcb3fb9d583958aa778263f84.subject: Fixed: Parsing URLs on some systems due to Locale
1ce378356645c21dcb3fb9d583958aa778263f84.reason: Real bug: RegexOptions.IgnoreCase without CultureInvariant uses the current culture, so under tr-TR the host class [-_A-Z0-9.] stops matching a lowercase i. Took RegexOptions.CultureInvariant rather than upstream's switch to [GeneratedRegex], which would mean dropping our RegexDefaults.Timeout convention.

7dd5365ccd5130b62b98f4bef9bfd69d7721aebc.subject: Fixed: Include quality modifier when augmenting quality from media info
7dd5365ccd5130b62b98f4bef9bfd69d7721aebc.reason: Not adaptable: our quality model has no Modifier concept at all. There is no Modifier enum under Qualities/, AugmentQualityResult carries no Modifier property, AggregateQuality tracks no modifier, and QualityFinder.FindBySourceAndResolution takes only (source, resolution). Introducing one would be a quality-matching design change, not a sync - and matching is not somewhere to make drive-by changes.

0134fdedcaff8eaeb6baaeee95e873a2b4881221.subject: Prevent overflow exception for big numbers in SizeSuffix and Fluent.Round
0134fdedcaff8eaeb6baaeee95e873a2b4881221.reason: Real crash, not a rounding nit: SizeSuffix(long.MinValue) negated to itself and recursed forever. Reproduced here - the new test case stack-overflows and aborts the whole test run without the fix. Round also floored negatives away from zero.

8ac3e4746a40390c4278e97af034f9dc710992c5.subject: Fixed: Testing qBittorrent after credentials change would always pass tests
8ac3e4746a40390c4278e97af034f9dc710992c5.reason: Both bugs are ours: the auth cookie cache was keyed on base URL + password only, and the session cookie went into the persistent container where it outlived the settings that made it. Took HttpRequestBuilder.StoreRequestCookie and the username in the cache key, covered by a new QBittorrentProxyV2Fixture (2 of its 6 tests fail without this). Did not take upstream's move of BasicNetworkCredential onto the login request alone - radarr/radarr@4dcc7c78 put it back in BuildRequest in 2026-06, which is where ours already is.

eec3efdb317bdfc81d1a18c0d3af76d6d10cb096.subject: New: API key support for qBittorrent
eec3efdb317bdfc81d1a18c0d3af76d6d10cb096.reason: Landed as our own #525: ApiKey setting, Bearer header in BuildRequest, the API-key branch in ProcessRequest, the validator rules forbidding username/password alongside a key, and the ApiKey/Username switch in TestConnection are all present. en.json already carries the reworded DownloadClientValidationAuthenticationFailureDetail.

ec1e57d05c87cd5d85117f8e1a2eeeb2a768c2fb.subject: Fixed: Validate source, modifier and resolution specifications
ec1e57d05c87cd5d85117f8e1a2eeeb2a768c2fb.reason: Took the ResolutionSpecification and SourceSpecification validators. 69f8ceaeb59021be314d7790a5eb1f38b99f10da.subject: Fixed: Improve cache busting for covers using a hash instead of file modification time
69f8ceaeb59021be314d7790a5eb1f38b99f10da.reason: Wanted, but deferred to its own PR by decision on 2026-08-30. Radarr's pick of Sonarr cecb4052e. 9d814137c12dae035e95ee14e3a2c079ce7d20db.reason: Identical code in our BasicRepository. Both bulk paths passed a null transaction, so each row committed separately - slow, and a partial write survived a mid-batch failure.

2089d4a33f2ffe0151cbab5ebb3b7ec48af3c34c.subject: Avoid suppresing search for movies errors
2089d4a33f2ffe0151cbab5ebb3b7ec48af3c34c.reason: Our SkyHookProxy talks to api.whisparr.com and sets SuppressHttpError on all ten of its call sites. Unsuppressing one of them is inconsistent, and upstream also drops AllowAutoRedirect, which we cannot verify against an endpoint we do not control. Worth its own PR if we want search failures to report their status code.

f3bb6321cdee98cf8f22c80acc26d847bd4ecba8.subject: Ignore case for rating type enums
f3bb6321cdee98cf8f22c80acc26d847bd4ecba8.reason: Fixes MapRatings' Enum.Parse calls in Radarr's SkyHookProxy. Our proxy has no MapRatings and no Enum.Parse over a rating type - ratings reach us already shaped from api.whisparr.com.

1737a7166976e077dc288081c3b47a85ac4ee79a.subject: Fix log message for MinCustomFormatScore rejection
1737a7166976e077dc288081c3b47a85ac4ee79a.reason: Same broken indices in our UpgradableSpecification: the format string referenced {3}/{4}/{5} against five arguments, so the score and the existing formats logged wrong.

750247fbe7dbcaa06b3b95ef52286b7c314d46f8.subject: Defer deserialize JSON response resource with Lazy
750247fbe7dbcaa06b3b95ef52286b7c314d46f8.reason: Moves deserialization out of the HttpResponse<T> constructor and into first Resource access, which relocates every throw site. Callers that build the response inside a try/catch and read .Resource outside it would start leaking exceptions. Upstream shipped no test for it and the gain is a deserialization we usually want anyway.

0c78421d553f8395fee14171892da60650123c97.subject: Fix disposing of the HttpRequestMessage
0c78421d553f8395fee14171892da60650123c97.reason: Identical code in our ManagedHttpDispatcher. HttpRequestMessage and its ByteArrayContent were never disposed on any request. Also unwraps the stray block left behind when SendAsync moved to a using declaration.

cca615b8e685e8a6d04382d8d37795dcbcb3366b.subject: HTTP Basic Auth credentials with non-ASCII characters
cca615b8e685e8a6d04382d8d37795dcbcb3366b.reason: Identical ManagedHttpDispatcher here. ISO-8859-1 substitutes '?' for anything outside Latin-1, so a password with an accent or a non-Latin script was sent as a different string and the login failed silently. Tested with a loopback listener that reads the header off the wire rather than adding another httpbin.servarr.com test.
